name: homelab
description: Deploy and operate apps on the lacrevetteserver homelab. Encodes the server's Docker Compose + Caddy + Tailscale conventions, its known footguns, and safety guards, so any project can be shipped to it consistently.

ssh_user.title: SSH user
ssh_user.description: Login user on the homelab server.

hostname.title: Expected hostname
hostname.description: What `hostname` must print on the far end of the SSH connection. Every remote command is refused unless it matches, so commands can never land on the wrong machine.

lan_host.title: LAN address
lan_host.description: Address of the server on the home network. Tried first; falls back to the Tailscale address.

ts_host.title: Tailscale address
ts_host.description: Tailscale IP of the server, reachable from anywhere on the tailnet.

ts_name.title: Tailscale MagicDNS name
ts_name.description: The server's *.ts.net name. This is the hostname Caddy routes on and the one Tailscale holds a Let's Encrypt certificate for.

apps_root.title: Apps directory
apps_root.description: Remote directory holding one folder per Compose project.

lan_subnet.title: LAN subnet
lan_subnet.description: CIDR used when opening a port to the home network with ufw.

docs_dir.title: Homelab docs repo
docs_dir.description: Local clone of the homelab documentation, kept in step after each deployment.
